## Why This Is Asked

- Azure Entra ID auth integration
- TLS endpoint exposure and basic governance
- GitHub Actions for CI/CD
- Cross-region DR for SQL, cost governance

## Code Example
```yaml
# GitHub Actions workflow skeleton
name: Deploy SPA/API/DB
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: azure/login@v1
      - name: Deploy SPA
        run: az staticwebapp create --name <name> --resource-group <rg> --location <loc>
      - name: Deploy Functions
        run: az functionapp deployment source config-zip -g <rg> -n <func-app> --src <zip>
      - name: Deploy App Configuration flags
        run: az rest -u https://<config-endpoint>/kv?api-version=2020-06-01
```

```hcl
// Example: Terraform module invocation for the hub subscription
module "azure_data_platform_hub" {
  source                  = "./modules/azure_data_platform"

  tenant_a_subscription_id = var.tenant_a_subscription_id
  tenant_b_subscription_id = var.tenant_b_subscription_id
  
  // Core services
  enable_adls_gen2        = true
  enable_synapse          = true
  enable_azure_ml         = true
  enable_purview          = true
  
  // Security configuration
  enable_private_endpoints = true
  lighthouse_delegations  = local.lighthouse_config
  
  // Cost management
  daily_budget_usd        = 1000
  alert_email_addresses   = var.cost_alert_emails
}
```

- Terraform defines infrastructure as code
- GitHub Actions automates deployments
- Plan/apply stages ensure safe changes

**Cost Management**
- Budget alerts warn you of overspending
- Daily notifications keep you informed
- Helps control cloud costs
